podcast.title: Cultural Phenomenon of Late 1980s/Early 1990s
podcast.body: The Madchester sound, characterized by bands like The Stone Roses, Happy Mondays, The Charlatans, and Inspiral Carpets, was described as "all the rage" in the early 1990s, culminating in major events like the Spike Island concert. "The Mad Chester sound featuring bands like the Roses and the Happy Mondays and the Charlotons and the Inspiral Carpets was all the rage"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Popularity in Early 1990s UK
podcast.body: At the beginning of the 1990s, the Madchester Sound, featuring bands like The Stone Roses, The Happy Mondays, The Charlatans, and Inspiral Carpets, was "all the rage" in the UK. This scene culminated in The Stone Roses' legendary Spike Island gig in May 1990. "The Mad Chester Sound, featuring bands like The Roses and The Happy Mondays and The Charlotons and The Inspiral Carpets, was all the rage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
